scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@smartcart/web && npm run build --workspace=@smartcart/api
scripts.types:buy: wrangler types deploy/buy/worker-configuration.d.ts --config deploy/buy/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface BuyHostEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.deploy:buy: npm run build:buy && wrangler deploy --config deploy/buy/wrangler.jsonc --keep-vars --strict
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@smartcart/web && npm run test --workspace=@smartcart/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@smartcart/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@smartcart/api
